long_biography.plain_text:
Cameron McColl learned woodworking from his father, a carpenter. After graduating in engineering from Edinburgh University, he moved to Australia and helped develop a portable ultrasound scanner. His practical interests have continued beyond electronics: he has restored an Aston Martin DB9 convertible and collects historic scientific instruments.

For many years, McColl studied with Francis Lucille, a teacher of Advaita, travelling to attend his teachings while raising a family and running companies. He also serves as treasurer of Science and Nonduality, a non-profit organisation that brings science and spiritual inquiry into conversation.
